description: ISO container types: dimensions, door and roof openings, weights, capacity, ISO 6346 codes and typical cargo, each value cited.
note: Values are representative series from carrier fleets; individual containers vary by manufacturer and series. Max payload = max gross minus tare.

records.name: 20ft standard dry container
records.special_features: Lashing devices rated 1,000 kg each; lashing rings on top rails for hanging garments; forklift pockets on loaded 20ft boxes

typical_cargo.why: Suitable for any general cargo in cartons, crates or on pallets
Same weight limit as a 40ft box in half the length, so heavy goods fill weight before volume
Can be fitted with liner bags for bulk cargo such as malt
Lashing rings on the top rails for garment-on-hanger equipment

external_length_mm.notes: ISO 668 nominal external length, tabulated in HL-01 p.5

internal_height_mm.notes: Product page gives 2,395; series vary 2,393 to 2,395

max_gross_kg.notes: Wooden-floor series. Product page (HL-02) shows a 30,480 kg series; older boxes and other carriers often rate 30,480 kg

tare_kg.notes: Series range 2,250 to 2,570 kg (HL-01); product page 2,350 kg

max_payload_kg.notes: = max gross minus tare. Product page series: 28,130 kg

special_features.value: Lashing devices rated 1,000 kg each; lashing rings on top rails for hanging garments; forklift pockets on loaded 20ft boxes
